text: Program Overview The objective of civil engineering major is to fester high-level applicative talents who have comprehensive quality in the domain of humanity and science. The graduates will have solid foundation for specialty knowledge and have creative ability to fulfill the requirement of engineering practice in the future. After the training of fundamental principles and knowledge in the discipline of civil engineering as a qualified engineering, the graduates will be cultivated to be competent for the professional position such as construction, structural design, engineering investigation, management, engineering consulting, education, research and development in the engineering fields of civil architecture, highway, bridge, tunnel as well as railway.Program ObjectivesTo nurture qualified and skilled talents who are well-versed in Chinese language and culture, who will have a good grasp of knowledge in international trade, management, and finance as well as the experience in operating and handling real-life projects, especially those pertaining to Chinese economy, society, and who understand the Chinese culture values, so as to meet the demands of the fast changing world economy.Main Courses Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction,Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese, Civil Engineering Graphic, Structural Mechanics, Civil Engineering Measurement, Soil Mechanics, Foundation Engineering, Civil Engineering Materials, Design of Reinforced Concrete, Design of Steel Structures, Civil Engineering Construction.Characteristic Course Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Duration 2.5 Years Degree Awarded Master Degree of Engineering. Career You will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies.
